row.name: The Travelers Companies Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=38 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.3 tightness=0.77 base_volume_vs_leg=0.72 base_volume_vs_avg=0.9
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 38 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -1.9% vs its 20-SMA, -1.2% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 1 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The VOL check is a hard FAIL: the base is 38 sessions long (well outside the 3–20 window), which triggers the catalyst-volume requirement, and burst-day volume came in at only 0.76× the 50-session average with a rank of 42 out of 60 — nowhere near the 1.5× threshold needed. The base itself is visually wide and extended across the shaded region from early August through late September, with multiple overlapping red and green bars of similar size showing no real tightening, and tightness of 0.77 confirms the loose shape. These two independent flaws — a measured VOL FAIL and a visually loose, overlong base — together pull the setup below A quality.
claude.key_risk: Volume confirmation is absent on a long, loose base that requires a catalyst-level surge, meaning any follow-through is unsupported by institutional participation.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the prior session's close (~356.51) or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below average, confirming the lack of institutional interest.
